The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Cantebarius H. Broom]] maintained a '''secret laboratory''' aboard an [[Unidentified space station (Broom)|unidentified]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In that [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], Broom used to capture [[Droid/Legends|droids]], remove their [[memory diskette]]s and dismantle them. The room featured several [[Computer/Legends|computers]], and its roof was equipped with a hidden trapdoor through which the professor's droid victim would fall. He did this out of paranoia that droids were after him, due to his discovery that the [[Great Heep]] was not only of the [[Abominor]] species, but there were no less than eighteen Abominors in the galaxy, including the then-deceased Great Heep.
